title: Contumacious
summary: CONTUMACIOUS, adjective [Latin , to swell.] 1. Literally, swelling against; haughty. Hence, obstinate; perverse; stubborn; inflexible; unyielding; disobedient; as a contumacious child. 2. In law, wilf

inlines.v: CONTUMACIOUS, adjective [Latin , to swell.] 1. Literally, swelling against; haughty. Hence, obstinate; perverse; stubborn; inflexible; unyielding; disobedient; as a contumacious child. 2. In law, wilfully disobedient to the orders of a court.
